questions.question: Write a Python function to find the middle element of a singly linked list, and explain the time and space complexity of your solution.
questions.answer: def find_middle(head):    slow = head    fast = head    while fast and fast.next:        slow = slow.next        fast = fast.next.next    return slow

strengths: Correct implementation of the slow and fast pointer technique
gaps: Did not explicitly explain the time and space complexity of the solution
evaluation.feedback: Good answer with room for more practical detail and explicit explanation of time and space complexity.
